products.title: High-Carbon Spring Steel Wire
products.description: Our flagship product, available in over 30+ gauge sizes. Manufactured in premier Chinese mills with precision cold-drawing and heat treatment.
specs: Carbon Content: High carbon formulation for maximum tensile strength
Packaging: Coils wrapped in protective plastic / burlap
Application: Mattress springs, garage door springs, compression springs

products.title: Stainless Steel Spring Wire
products.description: High-grade stainless steel wire imported directly from India. Delivers exceptional corrosion resistance, uniform temper, and bright, clean surface finishes.
specs: Material: Premium Stainless Steel Spring Grade
Corrosion Resistance: Ideal for humid, chemical, or outdoor environments
Elasticity: Precision rebound and fatigue endurance
Application: Precision machinery, marine springs, valves, food equipment

products.title: Galvanized & Bulk Indents
products.description: Galvanized zinc-coated spring wire for enhanced rust prevention, plus custom indent container orders tailored to your factory's exact wire specifications.
specs: Zinc Coating: Uniform electro-galvanized or hot-dip options
Indent Capacity: Container-load import orders handled seamlessly
Custom Diameters: Any metric or imperial gauge upon request
Application: Heavy industrial coils, agricultural implements, wire forms
